originalTitle: Chawinga sisters fire Malawi into Wafcon final
title: Malawi's Super Sisters Score Big! They Go To The Grand Final!
content:
Hello, Amazing Kids of Africa!

Hello, hello, everyone! Your friendly news reporter here, bringing you super exciting news from our beautiful continent, Africa! Get ready for a story about two amazing sisters and their incredible football adventure!

Meet Our Football Superstars!

Our story is about two fantastic football players, Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga. They are sisters, and they come from a country called Malawi! Malawi is a lovely country in southern Africa. These sisters are not just good at football; they are superstars! They run, they kick, and they score goals! They play for their country, Malawi, in big, important games. And guess what? They just did something truly amazing!

The Big African Football Party!

Tabitha and Temwa were playing in a very special football competition. It's like the biggest football party for women in all of Africa! Many countries send their best women players to play for a big trophy. It's called the Women's Africa Cup of Nations. It's a long name, but it just means a super important tournament where countries compete for the best football team in Africa!

Did You Know?

Did you know that football is the most popular sport in the world? Millions of people play it and watch it! All you need is a ball and some friends to play!

The Exciting Semi-Final Game!

Our sisters, Tabitha and Temwa, were playing in a game called the 'semi-final.' What's a semi-final, you ask? It means it was the game right before the very, very last game! If you win the semi-final, you get to play in the big grand final! So, it was a very important match! Malawi's team, which is sometimes called 'The Scorchers' (isn't that a cool name?!), played against another country called Algeria. It was a tough game, but our sisters were ready!

Sister Power On The Field!

The game started, and everyone was watching. Both teams wanted to win very much. But Tabitha and Temwa, with their amazing sister power, decided it was their time to shine! They worked together like magic. Tabitha scored not one, but two incredible goals! Imagine that! Two times the ball went into the net! The crowd cheered so loudly, you could almost hear it all the way across Africa! Then, her sister, Temwa, showed her skills too! She scored another fantastic goal! So, between them, the sisters scored three goals for Malawi! Wow!

Did You Know?

Did you know that when sisters play together, they often know what the other is thinking? They can pass the ball without even looking, because they are so used to playing with each other! It's like a secret language on the field!

Malawi Wins! To The Final!

Because of the sisters' amazing goals, Malawi won the game 3 goals to 1! Three-one! That's a great win! And what does that mean? It means Malawi is going to the grand final of the Women's Africa Cup of Nations! Can you believe it?!? This is like a dream come true for Malawi! Their team has never, ever been to the final of this big competition before. It's a truly historic moment!

A Whole Country Is Cheering!

Imagine how happy everyone in Malawi is right now! People are dancing, singing, and celebrating! The sisters, Tabitha and Temwa, have made their whole country so proud. They showed everyone what teamwork and hard work can do.

More About Our Super Sisters

Tabitha and Temwa started playing football when they were very young, just like many of you might be doing right now! They practiced a lot, running around, kicking the ball, and dreaming of playing for their country. And look at them now! They are making history! They play for big clubs in other countries too, but when it's time to play for Malawi, they always come back with all their heart and energy. That's true patriotism!

Did You Know?

Malawi is famous for its beautiful Lake Malawi, which is one of the biggest lakes in Africa! It's so big, it's sometimes called the 'Calendar Lake' because it's about 365 miles long and 52 miles wide – one mile for each day and week of the year!

Why This Is So Special For All Of Us!

This story of the Chawinga sisters is not just about football. It's about dreaming big, working hard, and never giving up. It's about sisters helping each other and making their country proud. It shows all the boys and girls in Africa that if you have a passion and you work together, you can achieve amazing things! Maybe one day, you too will be a superstar in your favorite sport or hobby! Let's all cheer for Malawi and their amazing sisters, Tabitha and Temwa, as they get ready for the big final! Go, Scorchers, go! You make Africa proud!
summary: Malawi's football team, led by super sisters Tabitha and Temwa Chawinga, won their semi-final game 3-1 against Algeria, with the sisters scoring all three goals, sending Malawi to the Women's Africa Cup of Nations final for the very first time!
whyMatters: This matters because the Chawinga sisters show how teamwork and hard work can make big dreams come true for their country, inspiring all kids in Africa to follow their passions.

originalTitle: Half a tonne of Erling Haaland branded cocaine seized in Ecuador
title: Police Find Mystery Boxes with a Football Star's Picture!
content:
Hello, Friends!

Hi everyone! It's your friendly reporter here, bringing you some important news from far away. We are going to talk about something that happened in a country called Ecuador. It's a place with beautiful mountains and sunny beaches, far across the ocean from us. Sometimes, even in nice places, some people try to do bad things. But guess what? There are always brave heroes to stop them! Today's story is about those heroes and a very famous football player!

Who is Erling Haaland?

Have you ever watched football, also called soccer? It's a game where players kick a ball into a goal. It's so much fun to watch! Well, there's a super-duper famous football player named Erling Haaland. He is from a cold country far away called Norway. Erling Haaland is very, very good at kicking goals. He scores so many goals that people call him a "goal machine"! He runs super fast and is very strong. Lots of kids, and grown-ups too, love watching him play. He is a real hero on the football field because he plays fair and works hard. **Did you know?** Erling Haaland is so tall, he can almost touch the sky! He is one of the best football players in the whole wide world!

Mystery Boxes Found!

Now, imagine this. Far, far away in Ecuador, there were some big, heavy boxes. These boxes were not filled with toys or yummy snacks. Oh no! They were filled with something very bad. It was a dangerous white powder that can hurt people very much. It's not candy, and it's definitely not medicine. It's something that grown-ups should never touch, and kids should *never, ever* go near. Some people were trying to hide this bad stuff and send it to other places. That's a very wrong thing to do. **Did you know?** Police officers wear special uniforms so you can easily spot them when you need help! They are our friends.

Erling Haaland's Picture Was There!

Guess what was on these bad boxes? Pictures of Erling Haaland! Yes, our football hero's face was printed right on them. And his name, "Haaland," was there too. Why would bad people put a good person's picture on bad stuff? We don't know for sure, but maybe they thought it would make the boxes look normal, or maybe they just liked his picture. But it was not okay. Erling Haaland had nothing to do with these bad boxes. He is a good person who loves football, not bad stuff. It was a very sneaky trick by the bad people. **Did you know?** There are over 250 million people around the world who play football regularly! That's a lot of players!

Brave Police to the Rescue!

But don't worry! There are always brave heroes to stop bad people. In Ecuador, the police are those heroes. Police officers are special people who help keep everyone safe. They wear uniforms, and they drive cars with flashing lights. Their job is to find bad stuff, stop bad people, and protect all of us. The police in Ecuador were very, very clever. They found these mystery boxes! They found hundreds and hundreds of them. That's a lot of boxes! Imagine a whole room full of these big boxes. **Did you know?** Police dogs are super smart and help police officers find hidden things with their amazing sense of smell! Woof woof!

What Did the Police Do?

When the police found the boxes with Erling Haaland's picture and the dangerous white powder inside, they knew exactly what to do. They didn't touch it without protection. They carefully took all the boxes away. They made sure that this bad stuff could not hurt anyone. This is called "seizing" the bad stuff. It means they found it and took it away so it couldn't cause trouble anymore. They stopped the bad people from sending it to other places. Yay for the police! **Did you know?** Police cars often have sirens that make loud noises to let people know they are coming and need to get somewhere fast to help!

Why Is This Important?

This news story might seem a bit grown-up, but it's important for us to know. It shows us that there are always good people, like the police, who are working hard to keep our world safe. It shows us that even if someone tries to do something sneaky and bad, they will get caught. Erling Haaland is a hero on the football field, and the police are heroes in real life. They are looking out for all of us, making sure we can play and learn in a safe world. **Did you know?** Being kind to others and following rules helps make our communities safe and happy for everyone!

How Much Bad Stuff Was There?

The police found a very, very big amount of this dangerous white powder. It was half a tonne! What does "half a tonne" mean? Imagine a very, very big elephant. That's a tonne! So, half a tonne is like half of a big elephant. Can you imagine carrying half of an elephant? It's super heavy! This shows just how much dangerous stuff the brave police stopped from hurting people. It was a huge discovery! **Did you know?** There are many different kinds of police officers, like those who ride horses, or those who help lost animals!

What Happens Next?

Now that the police have taken away all the bad boxes, they will try to find the people who put them there. They want to make sure these bad people can't do such things again. This is how police work helps keep our world fair and safe for everyone. Erling Haaland can keep playing football and scoring goals, knowing that his name was used by bad people, but good people helped stop them. It's a reminder that good always wins over bad! **Did you know?** If you ever get lost or need help, you can always go to a police officer. They are there to protect you!

Always Be Safe!

Remember, kids, if you ever see anything that looks strange or suspicious, especially if it's something grown-ups say is dangerous, tell a trusted adult right away. Never touch it! Your parents, teachers, or any trusted adult will know what to do. The police are our friends, and they are always ready to help keep us safe and sound. This story shows us that even though bad things can happen, there are always heroes in blue, like the police, who are ready to make things right. And it shows us that our heroes, like Erling Haaland, are good people who play fair. Let's cheer for the police and for all the good people in the world!
summary: Police in Ecuador found many boxes filled with dangerous white powder that had football star Erling Haaland's picture on them, and they took all the bad stuff away to keep people safe.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows how brave police officers work hard to stop bad things from hurting people, keeping our world safe for everyone to play and learn.
